subject: Reading the electronic oil level from the turn-signal stalk, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Start, check for leaks, verify the level electronically".

mustShow.text: HERO: The small button on the turn-indicator lever that is pressed up or down repeatedly to step through the on-board computer displays until OIL appears.
The second button on the turn-indicator lever pressed once the OIL symbol is showing to start the oil level check.
The instrument cluster area where the OIL symbol and the level message (OK, being checked, below minimum, too high) appear.
